subject: Information Theory
title: Echo Chambers
description: A short lesson to help you apply Echo Chambers.

hook.text: You see political posts you agree with. Your friend sees the opposite. Same platform, parallel realities. Echo chambers.

buildup.text: Algorithmic feeds maximize engagement by showing content you'll interact with—usually content you already agree with.

discovery.text: In information terms, echo chambers reduce the entropy of your information diet. Less diversity, less surprise.

twist.text: People also self-sort: they choose friends and sources that confirm their views. Algorithms amplify, not create, this.

climax.text: Low-entropy info diets produce high-confidence, low-accuracy beliefs. Certainty without exposure to contrary evidence.

punchline.text: Hear only agreement. Believe you're right. Echo chambers shrink information.

quiz.question: How do echo chambers affect information entropy?
options: They reduce it by limiting diversity of information
